user.title: Set up HA Self-Healing Agent
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the running Self-Healing Agent backend.

data_description.agent_url: URL of the agent backend (e.g. http://localhost:8765)
data_description.agent_mode: advisory = recommendations only, approval = human confirmation required, autonomous = self-applying
data_description.scan_interval: How often the agent should analyze logs (in seconds)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to agent backend. Is it running?
error.invalid_response: Agent responded with an invalid status.
error.unknown: Unknown error. Please check the logs.

findings_detected.title: HA Self-Healing Agent: Findings detected
findings_detected.description: The agent detected {count} finding(s) in your Home Assistant configuration. Open the agent dashboard for details and repair suggestions.

security_critical.title: Critical security issue detected
security_critical.description: The security agent detected a critical security issue: {title}. Immediate review recommended.

approval_required.title: Repair approval required
approval_required.description: A repair action is waiting for your approval: {title}. Use the ha_self_healing_agent.approve_repair or ha_self_healing_agent.reject_repair service.
